concepts.name: Root Vegetables
concepts.description: Edible roots such as carrots, beets, radishes, turnips, and parsnips. Sold fresh or bunched, ideal for roasting, salads, and pickling.

concepts.name: Leafy Greens
concepts.description: Tender or hearty edible leaves like kale, chard, arugula, and beet greens. Great for salads, sautés, and smoothies.

concepts.name: Brassicas
concepts.description: Flowering and heading brassicas such as cauliflower and related cultivars. Known for sweet-earthy flavors and high nutrition.

concepts.name: Alliums
concepts.description: Onion-family vegetables including onions, garlic scapes, chives, and similar aromatics. Used as flavor bases or garnishes.

concepts.name: Cucumbers
concepts.description: Fresh slicing and mini cucumbers with thin skins and crisp texture. Ideal for salads, snacking, and sandwiches.

concepts.name: Summer Squash
concepts.description: Tender-skinned squashes like zucchini and pattypan. Best grilled, sautéed, or lightly roasted.

concepts.name: Winter Squash
concepts.description: Hard-skinned squashes such as spaghetti squash and pumpkin types. Suited to roasting, mashing, and baking.

concepts.name: Specialty Peppers (Mild)
concepts.description: Mild, thin-skinned peppers like shishito and padrón. Typically blistered or grilled and finished with salt.

concepts.name: Fresh Tomatoes
concepts.description: Slicing, cherry, heirloom, and sauce/paste tomatoes. Used raw for salads or cooked for sauces and roasts.

concepts.name: Fresh Beans & Peas
concepts.description: Fresh pod vegetables such as green beans and heirloom bean varieties. For quick sautés, blanching, or salads.

concepts.name: Potatoes
concepts.description: Culinary potatoes including Yukon Gold, purple, and fingerling types. Excellent for mashing, roasting, and frying.

concepts.name: Sweet Potatoes & Yams
concepts.description: Sweet-fleshed root tubers in orange or purple varieties. Great roasted, mashed, or baked as wedges.

concepts.name: Fresh Mushrooms
concepts.description: Foraged and cultivated mushrooms like morels and shiitake. Valued for umami and meaty texture.

concepts.name: Microgreens & Sprouts
concepts.description: Tender shoots such as sunflower microgreens, sprouts, and pea shoots. Concentrated flavor and nutrients for garnish or salads.

concepts.name: Culinary Herbs & Blossoms
concepts.description: Fresh herbs (basil, parsley, dill, thyme) and edible blossoms. Provide aromatic, bright accents to dishes and drinks.

concepts.name: Berries
concepts.description: Fragile, sweet-tart fruits like strawberries and blueberries. Eaten fresh, in desserts, or infused into beverages.

concepts.name: Orchard Fruit
concepts.description: Pome and related fruits such as apples and pears. Used for fresh eating, baking, ciders, and butters.

concepts.name: Stalks & Cobs Vegetables
concepts.description: Crisp stalk or cob produce like celery hearts and sweet corn. Great for snacking, soups, and grilling.

concepts.name: Prepared Salad Kits & Shreds
concepts.description: Ready-to-use cut produce blends like slaws and salad mixes. Convenient base for quick sides and meals.

concepts.name: Eggs & Egg Dishes
concepts.description: Fresh eggs and ready-to-eat specialties such as smoked or pickled eggs, egg bites, and frittata cups.

concepts.name: Milk (Plain)
concepts.description: Unflavored dairy milk in various fat levels (whole, 2%, skim). A staple for drinking, cooking, and baking.

concepts.name: Flavored & Specialty Milks
concepts.description: Milk beverages enhanced with chocolate, strawberry, vanilla, or seasonal flavors like eggnog.

concepts.name: Cream & Cooking Cream
concepts.description: Heavy cream and lighter cooking creams. Used for whipping, sauces, and enriching dishes.

concepts.name: Butter & Ghee
concepts.description: Salted or unsalted dairy butters, including specialty milk butters. Essential for baking, cooking, and spreading.

concepts.name: Cultured Dairy
concepts.description: Yogurt (regular or Greek), sour cream, and related cultured products. Tangy, creamy staples for snacks and cooking.

concepts.name: Cheese (Fresh & Soft)
concepts.description: Soft and fresh cheeses such as mozzarella, feta, chèvre, and cheese curds. Ideal for salads, spreads, and melting.

concepts.name: Cheese (Semi-Hard & Aged)
concepts.description: Firm and aged cheeses like cheddar, gouda, Swiss, Havarti, and pepper jack. Suited for slicing, grating, and boards.

concepts.name: Ice Cream & Gelato
concepts.description: Churned frozen dairy desserts in classic and seasonal flavors. Rich and creamy treats for any occasion.

concepts.name: Frozen Custard & Frozen Yogurt
concepts.description: Egg-enriched custards and tangy froyo. A lighter or eggy twist on traditional ice cream.

concepts.name: Hearth Breads & Sourdough
concepts.description: Artisan loaves including sourdough, rye, pumpernickel, and boules. Long-fermented for depth and chewy crumb.

concepts.name: Sandwich Loaves
concepts.description: Everyday loaves such as multigrain and cinnamon swirl. Built for slicing, toasting, and sandwiches.

concepts.name: Bagels & Rolls
concepts.description: Boiled-and-baked bagels and savory or seeded rolls. Chewy staples for breakfast and sandwiches.

concepts.name: Crackers, Crisps & Flatbreads
concepts.description: Thin, crunchy breads and crisps including rye crackers and seeded flatbreads. Pair with cheese, dips, and spreads.

concepts.name: Sweet Pastries & Donuts
concepts.description: Baked goods like muffins, croissants, cinnamon rolls, and donuts. Treats for breakfast or dessert.

concepts.name: Quick Breads & Cakes
concepts.description: Leavened without yeast, including banana breads, soda breads, and holiday cakes like fruitcake.

concepts.name: Hot Cereals & Porridge Mixes
concepts.description: Oatmeal, multigrain, and ancient-grain blends for hot breakfasts. Just add water or milk.

concepts.name: Baking Mixes
concepts.description: Dry mixes formulated for waffles, pancakes, and similar baked goods. Convenience with consistent results.

concepts.name: Flours & Meals
concepts.description: Milled grains and nuts like pastry flour and nut flours. Used for breads, pastries, and gluten-free baking.

concepts.name: Raw Nuts (In Shell)
concepts.description: Whole nuts sold in their shells for cracking at home. Fresh flavor and longer shelf life.

concepts.name: Raw Nuts (Shelled)
concepts.description: Unsalted, untoasted nuts like walnut halves. Ready for baking, cooking, or snacking.

concepts.name: Roasted & Savory Nuts
concepts.description: Roasted or smoked nuts seasoned with salt or umami glazes. Crunchy, protein-rich snacks.

concepts.name: Sweet-Glazed Nuts & Pralines
concepts.description: Candied, honeyed, maple, or chocolate-coated nuts. Dessert-like snacks and toppings.

concepts.name: Trail Mixes & Snack Blends
concepts.description: Mixed nuts, seeds, and dried fruits for on-the-go energy. Balanced sweet-salty crunch.

concepts.name: Plant-Based Jerky & Snacks
concepts.description: Savory, chewy snacks made from plants like mushrooms. A vegan alternative to traditional jerky.

concepts.name: Nut & Seed Butters
concepts.description: Creamy or crunchy spreads such as almond or hazelnut butter. Used on toast, in sauces, or baking.

concepts.name: Fruit Butters, Jams & Spreads
concepts.description: Cooked fruit spreads like pear butter and similar preserves. Smooth, spreadable, and naturally sweet.

concepts.name: Savory Condiments & Spreads
concepts.description: Mustards, herb spreads, and gourmet pastes like duxelles. Add punch to sandwiches, boards, and sauces.

concepts.name: Hot Sauces & Chile Condiments
concepts.description: Fermented or cooked chile sauces that bring heat and tang. For drizzling, marinating, and finishing.

concepts.name: Vinegars & Infusions
concepts.description: Culinary vinegars and fruit-infused vinegars. Used for dressings, pickling, and deglazing.

concepts.name: Pickled & Fermented Vegetables
concepts.description: Vegetables preserved by vinegar or lacto-fermentation, from classic pickles to kimchi-style sides.

concepts.name: Juices & Ciders
concepts.description: Cold-pressed or fresh-pressed fruit and vegetable juices, including apple cider and tomato juice.

concepts.name: Teas & Herbal Blends
concepts.description: Tea leaves and herbal infusions for hot or iced beverages. Includes fruit-forward, caffeine-free blends.

concepts.name: American New England
concepts.description: Seasonal farmstead cooking with apples, maple, and dairy. Think fresh cider, cheddar, and hearty breads.

concepts.name: American Midwest
concepts.description: Comforting, dairy-rich traditions with cheese curds, casseroles, and robust breads. Celebrates regional grains and farm fare.

concepts.name: American South
concepts.description: Pecan-forward sweets, sweet potatoes, and bold condiments. Balances comfort food with barbecue-friendly sides.

concepts.name: American Pacific Northwest
concepts.description: Forest and coast-driven cuisine with wild mushrooms, berries, and hazelnuts. Emphasis on foraged and local flavors.

concepts.name: Pennsylvania Dutch/Amish
concepts.description: Heritage preservation cuisine with pickled eggs, chow-chow, and hearty baked goods. Simple techniques, big flavor.

concepts.name: French Classic
concepts.description: Technique-driven cuisine featuring pastries, duxelles, and soft-ripened cheeses. Focus on butter, herbs, and balance.

concepts.name: Italian Regional
concepts.description: Ingredient-first cooking with San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and rustic breads. Sauces, roasts, and gelato shine.

concepts.name: Spanish Tapas
concepts.description: Small-plate culture showcasing blistered peppers, olive oil, and simple seasonings. Bold flavors with minimal fuss.

concepts.name: Greek Aegean
concepts.description: Fresh salads, feta, herbs, and olive oil-driven dishes. Bright, briny, and herbaceous profiles.

concepts.name: Irish Home Baking
concepts.description: Hearty quick breads like soda bread and simple pastries. Emphasizes buttermilk, grains, and homey comfort.

concepts.name: British Traditional
concepts.description: Classic tea-time and holiday bakes such as fruitcake. Savory staples often pair with pickles and dairy.

concepts.name: Central European (Germanic)
concepts.description: Rye breads, pumpernickel, and Alpine-style cheeses. Pickles and mustards add tang to rich fare.

concepts.name: Scandinavian/Nordic
concepts.description: Crisp breads, dill, and clean, preserved flavors. Celebrates rye, dairy, and light, fresh accents.

concepts.name: Japanese Izakaya
concepts.description: Casual small plates featuring blistered peppers and savory snacks. Umami-forward glazes like teriyaki are common.

concepts.name: Korean Fermented
concepts.description: Vibrant, tangy heat from kimchi and fermented sauces. Probiotic-rich sides amplify everyday meals.

concepts.name: Thai Herbal
concepts.description: Aromatic basil and citrusy herbs drive balance of sweet, sour, salty, and hot. Fresh, fast, and fragrant.

concepts.name: Mexican Traditional
concepts.description: Chiles like jalapeño, bright pickles, and corn-centric cooking. Zesty salsas and toppings elevate simple dishes.

concepts.name: Mediterranean Levantine
concepts.description: Herb-laden, olive oil-driven fare with tangy dairy and pickled accents. Emphasizes freshness and shareable spreads.

concepts.name: Jewish Deli
concepts.description: Bagels, rye breads, and brined pickles define this tradition. Comforting, savory staples built for layering flavors.

concepts.name: Farm-to-Table Modern American
concepts.description: Seasonally driven cooking highlighting peak produce, dairy, and grains. Minimal processing lets ingredients shine.
